text:
```yaml
name: Lint and Typecheck

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npx eslint .

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: lint
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run TypeScript check
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

  publish-dry-run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: typecheck
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run publish dry-run
        run: npm run publish-check
```
